policy: Every dataset in LAND2BIZ must have verified legal availability, clear attribution, and compliance with API terms of use. No unauthorized scraped data.

sources.name: Census of India 2011 + Tamil Nadu District Portal
sources.access_method: Open Public Government Data (Data Commons / District Handbooks)
sources.restrictions: Must retain historical 2011 labeling; post-2011 figures must be explicitly labeled ESTIMATED.
sources.attribution_text: Source: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India

sources.name: National ODOP Product List V32
sources.restrictions: Product assignment list only; does not guarantee demand or profitability.
sources.attribution_text: Source: One District One Product (ODOP) Initiative, Ministry of Food Processing Industries / DPIIT
sources.notes: Tamil Nadu rows 961-1015 in V32 release.

sources.name: National Industrial Classification 2008
sources.permitted_use: Business category to 5-digit NIC code mapping
sources.restrictions: Ambiguous category mappings must be marked NEEDS_VERIFICATION.
sources.attribution_text: Source: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)

sources.name: Household Consumption Expenditure Survey (HCES) 2022-23
sources.restrictions: Must NOT be converted into exact village-level spending claims. Use as Regional Demand Signal.
sources.attribution_text: Source: National Sample Survey (NSS), MoSPI, Government of India

sources.name: SIH 2026 Problem Brief (Core Loan Rules)
sources.permitted_use: Core loan & margin ratio baseline (10% margin / 90% loan)
sources.restrictions: Project simplification baseline for hackathon evaluation.
sources.notes: Baseline scheme caps: Rs 1.25L Micro, Rs 45L Term.

sources.name: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME)
sources.permitted_use: Subsidy matching for food processing projects
sources.restrictions: Credit-linked back-ended subsidy (35%, cap Rs 10L). Food processing activities only.
sources.attribution_text: Source: Ministry of Food Processing Industries (MoFPI)

sources.name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
sources.restrictions: Caps Rs 50L manufacturing / Rs 20L service. 3-year TDR lock-in + EDP training required.
sources.attribution_text: Source: Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC) / Ministry of MSME
sources.notes: General/Special category and Urban/Rural margin money matrix (15-35%).

sources.name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
sources.restrictions: Shishu (<=50k), Kishore (50k-5L), Tarun (5L-10L), Tarun Plus (10L-20L after Tarun repayment).
sources.attribution_text: Source: MUDRA / Department of Financial Services

sources.name: Stand-Up India (SUPI)
sources.permitted_use: Greenfield loan matching for SC/ST and Women entrepreneurs
sources.restrictions: Rs 10L - Rs 1Cr composite loan. Must be greenfield enterprise.
sources.attribution_text: Source: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance

sources.name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
sources.restrictions: 3% interest subvention up to Rs 2Cr for 7 years. Applicable agri infrastructure categories only.
sources.attribution_text: Source: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare (DA&FW)
sources.notes: Loan facility, not direct capital grant.

sources.name: Agri-Clinics and Agri-Business Centres (ACABC)
sources.restrictions: Requires 45-day MANAGE residential training. 36%/44% back-ended subsidy.

sources.name: LAND2BIZ Statutory Screening Rules R1-R6
sources.access_method: State Land Revenue & Municipal Regulations Matrix
sources.restrictions: Screening support only. Never guarantees legal or statutory approval.
sources.attribution_text: Source: Tamil Nadu Land Revenue Code / FSSAI / Gram Panchayat Guidelines

sources.name: NABARD Model Bankable Project Profiles
sources.permitted_use: Baseline capital & operating cost ranges for micro enterprises
sources.restrictions: ESTIMATED cost range baselines only. Requires local ground quotation.
sources.attribution_text: Source: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD)

sources.name: Reserve Bank of India Published Data
sources.permitted_use: Reference for banking standards and regulatory caps
sources.restrictions: Do not invent bank-specific lending rates or approval odds. Unquoted rates = NEEDS_VERIFICATION.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap + Overpass API
sources.permitted_use: Open geographic feature mapping (roads, water, amenities, business nodes)
sources.restrictions: Mapped objects only — NOT total ground truth. Mapped count = 0 does NOT mean zero exist.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap Nominatim Reverse Geocoder
sources.permitted_use: Location coordinate normalization (District / State name matching)
sources.restrictions: Location normalization only — never proof of business existence.
sources.notes: Requires custom User-Agent header per usage policy.

sources.name: Google Places API (New)
sources.permitted_use: Live commercial amenity count and place verification
sources.restrictions: Must comply with Google Cloud API Terms. Raw place content must not be stored beyond allowed caching. Retain Place IDs only.
sources.notes: Requires active GCP API key with Places API (New) enabled.

sources.name: M21 Ground Truth Checklists
sources.restrictions: User interactive tickbox only — NEVER auto-completed by system.
